home.subtitle: Start everyday office work, inspect current tasks, and manage the information your assistant can use.
home.startHint: Choose an example to place a complete instruction in the task box. Nothing runs until you send it.

reimbursement.title: Prepare a reimbursement package
reimbursement.prompt: Organize the attached invoices and receipts into a reimbursement checklist. Flag missing dates, amounts, categories, or approvals, and create a clear summary for me to review before submission.

requirements.title: Turn notes into requirements
requirements.prompt: Turn the attached notes into a requirements document with goals, users, scope, acceptance criteria, open questions, and risks. Mark every assumption and do not invent missing facts.

data.title: Analyze a data file
data.prompt: Analyze the attached spreadsheet. Check data quality first, then summarize key changes, unusual values, and conclusions supported by the data. Create a concise table of findings.

market.title: Prepare a market brief
market.prompt: Prepare a market brief for the topic I provide. Separate sourced facts from inference, compare the main alternatives, and list the evidence and dates behind each important conclusion.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.subtitle: These are your real conversations and their current state.
tasks.manageHint: Open a task to inspect its messages and state. Stop an active run, add files, or amend requirements in the conversation so the existing execution and history controls are preserved.
